decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf builds directly on the firm's existing food manufacturing knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and improve the product.
The guided historic mill tour is a tourism service unrelated to the firm's core food production capabilities, so the firm lacks the absorptive capacity to learn from early results and improve it.
The sweet pastry similarly leverages the firm's existing food processing and product development knowledge, supporting assimilation and commercial application of early feedback.
